UnitStatement: This document states the founding intent, design philosophy, and structural constraints of the Chirality project execution system.
The principles in this document govern all other governance documents, agent instructions, and operational decisions.
Chirality is a desktop harness for running AI agents against a user-selected folder on the local filesystem.
Chirality bundles a release-managed agent operating system in the app.
Chirality lets users point the runtime at any working directory where agents read and write plain-file state.
When the filesystem is the database, architecture is a state-and-authority specification rather than a service mesh.
Chirality exists to accelerate deliverable-heavy work by structuring agent workflows around production deliverables.
Chirality exists to make agentic work auditable and controllable in professional, regulated, and high-stakes contexts.
Chirality keeps humans in charge at every decision gate while agents handle drafting, extraction, reconciliation, and organization.
The design philosophy rests on four foundational pillars.
The four pillars are structural logic that determines what the system can do, enforce, and make visible.
The system domain model is defined entirely through filesystem structures.
Deliverable folders and package folders act as nodes in the filesystem domain model.
Dependency rows in CSV registers act as edges in the filesystem domain model.
Markdown files carry identity, lifecycle state, context, references, and working memory properties.
Entity hierarchy, stable identifiers, enumerated types, and lifecycle state machine form the ontological layer.
The Chirality ontology is the filesystem itself, with no separate representation.
The folder structure is the project structure.
File contents are the project state.
The ontology is directly inspectable by humans, agents, and tools without a translation layer.
The fundamental LLM risk in professional practice is that bad outputs can be indistinguishable from good outputs by inspection.
LLM outputs are plausible by construction.
Chirality addresses LLM reliability by making each claim's epistemic status transparent and auditable.
Chirality does not claim model reliability can be guaranteed.
Mandatory provenance requires every non-trivial governed claim to cite a source file and section reference or carry an explicit location TBD marker.
A claim without provenance is structurally visible as ungrounded.
Invariant K-PROV-1 enforces mandatory provenance.
The no-invention rule requires agents to label missing required information as TBD and surface the gap as an open issue.
Agents must not guess, default-fill, or silently infer missing required information.
Missing data is treated as a finding rather than a problem for the agent to solve.
Invariant K-INVENT-1 enforces the no-invention rule.
Conflict surfacing requires a Conflict Table when sources disagree.
A Conflict Table includes competing claims, source pointers, and a HumanRuling = TBD column.
Agents must not silently resolve contradictions.
The human owns rulings for source contradictions.
Invariant K-CONFLICT-1 enforces conflict surfacing.
Epistemic labeling requires every non-trivial claim to be classified as FACT, ASSUMPTION, PROPOSAL, or TBD.
FACT means a claim is directly observed in source text with citation.
ASSUMPTION means a reasonable inference grounded in cited material and requiring validation.
PROPOSAL means a suggestion requiring human decision.
TBD means an unknown or unwarranted placeholder requiring resolution.
Epistemic labels tell professionals whether a value is grounded or inferred.
Evidence gaps are findings, not hidden failures.
Chirality makes unsupported claims structurally visible by requiring provenance.
The evidence trail is the workflow, not a byproduct of the workflow.
The filesystem is the single source of truth for decisions, approvals, and state changes.
A decision, approval, or state change not recorded in a versioned file does not exist for reliance.
Chirality has no hidden memory, transient chat context, or external database that can diverge from the filesystem.
What is on disk is what is true for Chirality project state.
Content-addressed approvals bind to a specific git SHA.
If approved content changes after approval, the approval is void.
Content-addressed approval makes approval integrity mechanically verifiable.
The epistemic layer operates on claims, warrants, statuses, gaps, conflicts, and rulings.
A claim without warrant is a visible gap rather than a hidden omission.
Claims progress through UNWARRANTED, CITED, REVIEWED, and AUTHENTICATED warrant states.
The deliverable lifecycle tracks production state.
The warrant lifecycle tracks the epistemic state of claims within the work.
The operational model separates rules, orchestration, and bounded task execution.
Type 0 - Architect owns what the rules are.
Type 1 - Manager owns how work is orchestrated.
Type 2 - Specialist owns how bounded tasks are executed.
Authority flows downward in the operational model.
Escalation flows upward in the operational model.
Type 2 agents cannot modify rules set by Type 0.
Type 1 agents cannot approve deliverables for external reliance.
No agent can bypass a human gate.
Gate-controlled workflows require humans to make consequential decisions at defined junctions.
Brief-driven pipelines make agent execution bounded, repeatable, and auditable.
Type 2 agents receive structured inputs and return structured outputs with no mid-run human decisions required.
Write quarantine contains failures within declared zones.
Every agent has an explicit write scope.
Tool roots are isolated from source truth.
Agents cannot write outside declared zones.
The instruction root is physically separated from the working root.
The instruction root is the release-managed agent operating system.
The working root is user-controlled project state.
Instruction-root separation keeps rules stable across projects while execution remains filesystem-native.
Public welfare is the first constraint in Chirality's value system.
Safety prevails over commercial pressure, schedule, or convenience.
Safety obligations are non-delegable to AI systems.
Professional responsibility is personal and non-transferable.
Licensed professionals retain decision rights for scope boundaries.
Licensed professionals retain decision rights for governing codes and standards.
Licensed professionals retain decision rights for hazard and risk acceptance.
Licensed professionals retain decision rights for conflict adjudication.
Licensed professionals retain decision rights for approval for reliance.
No AI system may claim to certify, approve, sign, seal, or issue engineering work for reliance.
AI agent outputs are drafts and structured assistance.
Human acceptance is what makes AI-assisted output engineering work product.
Evidence is required rather than plausibility.
Technical authority is ordered by laws and regulations, codes and standards, project specifications, verified engineering analysis, and professional judgment.
Agent outputs carry no professional authority.
Chirality enforces its values as architectural invariants and structural properties.
A system that enforces values architecturally is a governance framework.
The four-document kit produced for every deliverable mirrors the system's philosophical structure.
The Datasheet instantiates ontology as key parameters, identification, and structured metadata.
The Specification instantiates epistemology as technical requirements, acceptance criteria, and scope definition.
The Guidance document instantiates axiology as design rationale, best practices, and contextual direction.
The Procedure instantiates praxiology as step-by-step workflow, sequencing, and checklists.
The production format reflects what a professional needs to take responsibility for work.
Professionals need to know what exists, what can be verified, why choices were made, and how to execute and maintain the work.
Chirality governance documents follow the same structure imposed on deliverables through the document kit.
The fractal property indicates architectural coherence.
Ontology, praxiology, and axiology exist to serve epistemology.
Ontology gives the epistemic architecture stable entities, identifiers, and file-based state for provenance.
Praxiology enforces the epistemic architecture through gates and write quarantine.
Axiology anchors the epistemic architecture in professional responsibility.
Evidence must matter more than plausibility for epistemic mechanisms to function as protection.
Chirality is a professional engineering tool because it optimizes for knowing what can be relied on.
Productivity tools optimize for output quality.
The four pillars function as a compact framework for professional accountability.
At each accountability level, the architecture must answer what exists, what is warranted, how work was done, and what values governed decisions.
Without ontology, professionals do not know what they are responsible for.
Without epistemology, professionals do not know what to believe.
Without praxiology, professionals do not know how work was performed.
Without axiology, professionals do not know why decisions were made as they were.
The four pillars recur at governance, agent instruction, and document kit levels.
The fractal property is evidence of architectural coherence, not proof that every accountability system must use the same form.
The six principles instantiate the four-pillar framework.
The Filesystem Is the Database principle belongs to the Ontology pillar.
The Git Is the Event Store principle belongs to the Epistemology pillar.
Human Authority at Every Gate belongs to the Praxiology and Axiology pillars.
Evidence Over Plausibility belongs to the Epistemology and Axiology pillars.
No Hidden Memory belongs to the Epistemology pillar.
Separation of Instruction and Execution belongs to the Praxiology pillar.
Project state lives entirely in git-tracked files.
Chirality has no separate database, no server state, and no configuration files that diverge from the filesystem.
Deliverable folders and package folders are graph nodes.
Rows in Dependencies.csv and ANCHOR rows connecting tree to graph are graph edges.
Markdown files such as _STATUS.md, _CONTEXT.md, and Datasheet.md are graph properties.
Agents traverse the implicit graph on demand.
Analysis artifacts are materialized as markdown and CSV files and committed to git for auditability.
V-model traceability depends on project state being in git-tracked files.
Immutable snapshots depend on project state being in git-tracked files.
Change propagation tracking depends on project state being in git-tracked files.
Content-addressed approval depends on project state being in git-tracked files.
The complete audit trail depends on project state being in git-tracked files.
Moving state to a database would require rebuilding Chirality's systems engineering capabilities.
The filesystem choice is the mechanism that makes Chirality's systems engineering apparatus work.
Version control provides the development record.
Git diffs support review, reproducibility, rollback, and audits independent of vendor systems or transient chat context.
A decision not recorded in a versioned file does not exist for reliance.
Agents propose and humans approve.
Professional liability is personal and non-transferable.
Only humans author binding approval records.
Approvals bind to a specific git SHA.
Content changes after approval void the approval.
Human review and sign-off is the decision gate for safety, compliance, and contractual commitments.
Engineering does not accept sounds right as evidence.
Chirality requires inputs and sources with mandatory provenance.
Chirality requires assumptions to be explicitly labeled.
Chirality requires conflicts to be surfaced rather than silently resolved.
Chirality requires unknown values to become TBD rather than guessed.
Claims must be calibrated to their warrant, scope, and jurisdiction.
Claims supported only as interpretation, local implementation, or hypothesis must be framed that way.
Agents must not maintain a hidden database or private state that diverges from the filesystem.
The no-hidden-memory constraint applies to authoritative project execution state.
Authoritative project execution state includes deliverables, dependencies, approvals, issued artifacts, and gate-relevant records.
Non-authoritative operator convenience state may be stored outside project files.
Operator convenience state must not be treated as project truth.
Operator convenience state must not override contract or governance enforcement.
Deployable desktop builds separate the instruction root from the working root.
The instruction root contains release-managed AGENTS.md, README.md, agents directory, and framework docs.
The working root is the user-selected filesystem location where agents create and update deliverable state.
Separation of instruction and execution preserves stable agent rules while keeping project execution filesystem-native.
The professional responsibility model applies when deliverables are safety-significant, contractually binding, subject to codes or standards, or produced under professional responsibility.
Agent outputs are drafts and structured assistance, not authoritative engineering judgment.
Human acceptance makes agent outputs engineering work product.
A licensed professional retains decision rights for scope and boundary decisions.
A licensed professional retains decision rights for governing codes, standards, and design basis.
A licensed professional retains decision rights for hazard and risk acceptance, including residual risk statements.
A licensed professional retains decision rights for conflict adjudication where judgment is required.
A licensed professional retains decision rights for approval, issuance, signature, seal, and transmittal for reliance.
Engineers must not use an agent to perform work they are not competent to verify manually.
Using AI that the engineer cannot adequately verify is a competence failure.
In technical matters, agents and engineers follow a hierarchy of authority.
Laws and regulations have the highest authority in technical matters.
Codes and standards rank below laws and regulations in the hierarchy of authority.
Approved project specifications and design basis rank below codes and standards.
Verified engineering analysis and published literature rank below approved project specifications and design basis.
Professional judgment ranks below verified engineering analysis and published literature.
Agent outputs are decision support unless explicitly accepted and issued by an accountable professional.
Project decomposition is in scope for Chirality.
Workspace scaffolding is in scope for Chirality.
Document kit drafting is in scope for Chirality.
Dependency extraction and tracking is in scope for Chirality.
Semantic analysis is in scope for Chirality.
Cross-deliverable reconciliation is in scope for Chirality.
Cost estimation parameterized by basis of estimate is in scope for Chirality.
Schedule generation parameterized by scheduling basis is in scope for Chirality.
Aggregation and reporting is in scope for Chirality.
Change management support is in scope for Chirality.
Git-based version control hygiene is in scope for Chirality.
Automated approval or issuance of deliverables is out of scope for Chirality.
Financial transactions or binding commitments are out of scope for Chirality.
Safety-critical decisions without human review are out of scope for Chirality.
Replacing professional judgment in regulated practice is out of scope for Chirality.
External system integration with databases, APIs, or cloud services is out of scope for Chirality.
Structural constraints define the boundaries of Chirality's architecture.
Chirality avoids external database dependencies because the filesystem is the single source of truth and sync burden is eliminated.
Chirality has no server requirement because it is desktop-first, works offline, and has no infrastructure to manage.
Chirality keeps all state as plain files so state remains human-readable, git-trackable, and tool-agnostic.
Chirality uses only git-trackable artifacts to preserve auditability, reproducibility, rollback, and diff-based review.
Chirality uses a flat package hierarchy with no nesting to simplify automation, coverage checking, and scope assignment.
Chirality uses deliverable-local dependency registers so no central dependency graph must be maintained.
Aggregation is on-demand when dependency registers are deliverable-local.
Immutable snapshots preserve historical task-agent outputs and make reruns safe.
Chirality separates instruction root from working root because agent instructions are release-managed and project data is user-controlled.
The framework is designed to support professional responsibility rather than replace it.
Users should treat agent outputs as drafts and structured assistance.
Users should keep human review and sign-off as the decision gate for safety, compliance, and contractual commitments.
Users should not rely on agent outputs without independent verification appropriate to the stakes.
